name: weather_sdk

installs._comment: Host wiring template: configureWeatherSdk() startup hook (shop-location resolver + remote-config key hydration point) and the AppWeatherWidget shell widget. Top-level (not app_type-gated) because the weather suite is role-agnostic - the whole library lives in src/common/. Hosts that don't render it pay only an unused file.

_comment_routes: Deliberately empty: the weather suite has no routed page on pos main - it is a header widget plus (large screens only) a dialog. If a standalone weather page is ever wanted, it becomes a template with @RoutePage here.

embedded_widgets._comment: Header slot (ADR-005): shells embed the compact adaptive widget without importing weather_sdk directly. inlineExpansion=false because headers are height-constrained; on small screens that leaves just the minimal icon+temp chip, and the popup-free WeatherInlineForecast card is placed in body flow via the weather_sdk barrel (it takes a WeatherState argument, so it cannot ride the zero-arg embedded-widget seam).

_comment_tr_keys: No tr_keys block: the ported suite ships pos main's hardcoded English strings verbatim (pos never translated this surface). Translating it is a recorded follow-up, not smuggled into the port.
_comment_secrets: No secret is committed anywhere in this SDK. The OpenWeatherMap key (extended forecast only) resolves from the OPEN_WEATHER_API_KEY dart-define and/or the host's remote-config bootstrap (pos main's get_remote_config pattern); the primary feed uses the tenant Frappe proxy with the user's bearer token.
